_note: FL00 sample fragment. Keys starting with _ or $ are ignored. A persistent flag (D2) with a global meaning, and one scene-scratch flag (D1) whose index means different things in two scenes. Not applied to db-us/flags.json.

meanings.name: ec_lance_letter_shown
meanings.summary: Will showed Lance's letter to the Edward's Castle left guard.

effects.set: ec0A_left_guard skips the intrusion dialog and clears the joypad lock bits ($CFFC of joypadMaskStd $065A).
effects.clear: ec0A_left_guard sets the joypad lock bits ($CFFC) on spawn and waits for the letter dialog, so the player cannot move.

meanings.notes: Runtime control (scene $0A with and without the flag) is recorded in db-us/scene-flags.json (source); FR00 turns it into a VERIFIED-RUNTIME result.

meanings.name: ir_lily_dialog_req
meanings.summary: Lily has printed her dialog line and waits for Kara to answer.

effects.set: ir1C_kara leaves WaitOnFlagByte(#02, #01) and clears the flag.

meanings.notes: Producer: ir1C_lily (sets, then waits for clear). Consumer: ir1C_kara (waits for set, then clears).
